assertions.assertion: The denial carries reason code CO-197.
CPT 93229 corresponds to Mobile Cardiac Telemetry.
A clinical indication note exists and documents the patient's presentation.
The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope.
The patient has transient neurological deficits suggestive of transient cerebral ischemic attacks.
The submitted diagnosis codes are R55 and G45.9.
Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to evaluate for underlying arrhythmias or hemodynamic instability.
The suspected arrhythmias/hemodynamic instability may be contributing to the syncopal events and cerebral hypoperfusion.
Authorization status is recorded as missing (prior authorization was not obtained).
The appeal is submitted with supporting clinical documentation.
The appeal is submitted 47 days after the date of service.
There are 133 days remaining before the filing deadline.
